# Cortex SDK

> Public TypeScript source for integrating Uthereal Cortex with your application.

- [Start here](https://github.com/Uthereal-Labs/cortex-sdk/blob/v1.0.0/README.md)
- [Integration guide](https://github.com/Uthereal-Labs/cortex-sdk/blob/v1.0.0/INTEGRATING.md): auth, storage, Ask, RAG, citations and PDFs
- [Public API contract](https://github.com/Uthereal-Labs/cortex-sdk/blob/v1.0.0/openapi.json)
- [Synthetic fixtures](https://github.com/Uthereal-Labs/cortex-sdk/tree/v1.0.0/examples): verify without credentials

Use sdk/server.ts on the server and sdk/browser.ts in the frontend. Preserve the
host application's instructions. Keep Cortex keys in server secrets. GitHub-only
distribution; clone/download the pinned revision and copy sdk/ intact.
